page_title: AUG 2-2 FRE | Augsburg v Freiburg 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+3' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Han-Noah Massengo as he is replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
86' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
85' The players claim that Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
84' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
83' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
82' The referee shows the yellow card to Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Max Rosenfelder (Freiburg) for Lukas Kubler.
80' The Freiburg players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
79' Freiburg score a goal, but referee Martin Petersen has now indicated he wants to check if the goal can stand using VAR!
78' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) thought he had scored but it was disallowed as the ball ran out of play in the build up.
75' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
75' Fabian Rieder goes off the pitch and Anton Kade (Augsburg) comes on.
73' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom left corner. His effort is blocked by Finn Dahmen with a brilliant diving save!
71' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Johan Manzambi.
63' Here is a change. Yannik Keitel is going off and Manuel Baum gives the last tactical orders to Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg).
63' A substitution has been made. Dimitrios Giannoulis is replaced by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
62' Martin Petersen rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg).
62' 2 - 2 Goal! Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 2:2.
62' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) handles the ball inside the box.
62' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) meets a cross and produces a header towards the left side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
61' Freiburg will take a corner kick.
60' 2 - 1 Magnificent finish by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) as he crashes a first-time shot from close range against the crossbar and into the back of the net!
59' Freiburg force a corner. They send men into the box.
59' A snap shot by Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen produces a good save to thwart him.
58' Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucas Holer departs the field of play to be replaced by Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vincenzo Grifo leaves the pitch and Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) comes on.
56' Julian Schuster has decided to substitute Jordy Makengo and he is replaced by Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg).
54' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
53' The whistle blows and Yannik Keitel (Augsburg) is booked for an infringement.
51' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
49' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) does well to meet a cross inside the box and produces a stunning header that goes inside the left post.
49' Augsburg quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
47' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:0.
46' Manuel Baum makes a switch. Elvis Rexhbecaj is coming on in place of Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+9' A rebound falls at the feet of Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
45+9' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45+8' Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) strikes a volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. The referee points to the corner flag and Augsburg will take a corner.
45+8' A quickly taken corner by Freiburg.
45+6' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) cushions the ball on his chest then hits a first-time volley well wide of the left post from inside the box.
45+3' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45+1' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
45+1' Martin Petersen couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) and blew his whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
41' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.

38' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
37' The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
35' Augsburg take a short corner kick.
35' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

34' Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg) receives a precise pass and finds some space for a shot. The keeper is alert and denies his long-range effort towards the roof of the net. Decent save! Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
33' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
33' Freiburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

33' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Noah Atubolu shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
28' Freiburg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
27' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
27' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Freiburg comes to nothing.
27' The free kick is taken by Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg), but ball is cleared. Good work from Freiburg as they win a corner.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
23' It looks like Matthias Ginter (Freiburg) saw red with that tackle. Martin Petersen won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Augsburg get a free kick.
22' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.

20' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) leaps highest around the penalty spot to meet a cross from the free kick and produces a promising goal-bound header towards the left post, but Noah Atubolu pulls off a fine save to deny him.
17' The corner is swung in but Freiburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
16' Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play. Freiburg are awarded a corner kick.
15' The referee blows his whistle as Jordy Makengo (Freiburg) was too aggressive in his challenge.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
12' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
6' The game is interrupted.
4' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
3' Flag up against Jordy Makengo (Freiburg). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Martin Petersen was nominated as the referee for this game.
